title: Environmental Justice and Gender
description: Examines how gender plays an inextricable role in the climate crisis. Reading diverse perspectives from frontline communities, movement leaders, social and climate scientists and policymakers. Develops a complex understanding of how the structures that produce climate change are shaped by and shape gender.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GNDR 230,GNDR 225, GNDR 219 (if taken in the same topic), GNDR 329 (if taken in the same topic).
